articles.title: Motherhood, Misery, Medal: Seema Kaliramna's Comeback Story
articles.summary: Indian discus thrower Seema Kaliramna achieved an inspiring comeback, securing a Commonwealth Games bronze medal. Her remarkable feat came despite battling post-childbirth arthritis and managing motherhood challenges, showcasing immense determination and resilience. This story highlights the power of perseverance in overcoming personal obstacles to achieve excellence on an international platform, a valuable lesson for all aspirants.

articles.title: Longtime QVC host Rick Domeier announces retirement after 30 years: ‘A road I’ve never been on before’
articles.summary: Longtime QVC host Rick Domeier announced his retirement after 32 years with the network, effective end of year. His departure marks the end of a significant career in television retail, concluding a decades-long association with the popular shopping channel.

articles.title: Govt approves National Offshore Exploration Scheme
articles.summary: India's Cabinet approved the Petroleum Ministry's 'Samudra Manthan,' a National Offshore Exploration Scheme, with an ₹84,084 crore outlay until FY 2030-31. This strategic initiative targets enhancing national energy security and reducing import dependence through accelerated offshore resource exploration. It represents a significant push towards indigenous resource harnessing, contributing to India's economic stability.
